context: The previous night Astarion attempted to bite the Avatar during camp, and this morning the player can confront him about that incident. Astarion is a vampiric companion who leans into flirtation with a hungry, predatory edge; in the talk he’ll be defensive, provocative, and prone to testing moral boundaries by arguing about who counts as an “animal” to feed on. Off‑screen the party is traveling together after the crash and Avernus and is searching for a druid; other companions are in camp with their own moods and may voice opinions. Depending on earlier choices, Astarion may already have bitten you or you may have fought him off, and this scene lets the Avatar set firm limits, bargain, or threaten consequences.
